name: global
purpose: Services with no region at all - IAM, Route 53, CloudFront, Organizations, WAF. Drawn OUTSIDE the region box, which is where AWS's own architecture diagrams put them. Being global is a fact about the resource, not a rendering choice.

name: account
purpose: The account boundary. One synthetic node from STS; filtering here scopes the whole diagram.

name: region
purpose: A physical region. Contains VPCs and, beside them, every regional service that lives outside a VPC.

name: vpc
purpose: The network boundary and outermost drawn box inside the region. Regional and spans zones - it is NOT inside an AZ. Filtering here cascades to every subnet and workload beneath it.

name: az
purpose: Availability-zone columns drawn inside each VPC. Synthetic nodes keyed per-VPC because a diagram renders one column set per VPC.

name: subnet
purpose: The join of an AZ and a VPC - a subnet belongs to exactly one of each. Where the spatial hierarchy stops being a tree.

name: workload
purpose: Compute and data inside a subnet: instances, databases, VPC-attached functions and tasks.

name: attached
purpose: Bound to a workload rather than to the network: volumes and network interfaces. Nests inside its workload, so an attachment reads as containment rather than as a stray arrow.

name: regional
purpose: Regional services that sit in the region but in NO VPC: S3, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, KMS, ECR, and Lambda functions with no VpcConfig. Drawn as a band beside the VPC, not floating outside the diagram - they really are in the region.

name: network
purpose: Security groups, NACLs and route tables. VPC-scoped, so they belong in the VPC box - but one security group spans subnets and AZs, so they are grouped rather than nested and default to hidden.

name: image
purpose: AMIs, snapshots and launch templates. Regional, but provenance rather than position, so hidden unless asked for.

name: uncollectable
purpose: Types with no read API - mostly CloudFormation deploy-time-only resources. They can never appear in an inventory, so landing here means 'cannot be collected', not 'not yet classified'.
